 A FIELD GUIDE

Take your time here.

Click a building on the map, or choose an entrance below, to step into its little world.

Explore the map
Drag inside the canvas to explore. Scroll, pinch, or use + / − in the top banner to zoom. Select ⊞ to reset the panoramic view.
Places to visit
Read and write notes, compose a tune, run a cellular experiment, or make pixel art.
Keyboard
Use the arrow keys to move, + / − to zoom, H for the overview, and Esc to leave a building.
Language
Use the English / 中文 button to switch languages. Your notes, music, and artwork stay in place.
